name: Alexis Grey

text.trigger: A player controls Alexis Grey and is not exiled.
text.vignette: Alexis finds herself among the library shelves again, running a finger down spines nobody has touched in months. Part of her wants to curl up there with a stack of manuals and never leave; another part cannot stand to watch the building slowly rot.

options.stay-and-read: Alexis is placed at the Library (not a move) and can never move away from it again.
options.walk-away: Alexis is placed in the colony (not a move) and can never move to the Library again.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #34; The printed "place at the Library, if able" happens first in the source; here the stay option places her (if there is room) and the walk-away option puts her straight in the colony.
